title: Qt: Rename ByteViewTab to DataSourceTab
description:
ByteViewTab can contain either a byte (hex dump) view or a JSON view
into data sources, so rename it to DataSourceTab.

notes.body: I plan on renaming ByteViewText in a separate commit.
